detailed_descriptions.en: What am I in for? Welcome to the world of Endacopia! You're in for a surreal Point and Click Adventure full of unsolved mysteries, abstract puzzles, hostile monsters, and horrors that lurk in the shadows... if tampered with, of course. You'll be guiding a young boy named Mellow who has lost all his senses in an attempt to escape an uncomfortable home. What do I do? First and foremost, you'll need a functional keyboard and mouse to play this game. Once you've taken care of that, prepare yourself to use your brain for the following scenarios: Decide which area to explore next in whichever order you'd like. Use Mellow's bare fists to block, dodge, and punch monsters in first person perspective. Have conversations with strange individuals who may or may not help you on your quests. Fill your pockets with tools, toys, gadgets, and trash. Try your luck at a variety of mini-games. Gaze at an abundance of animated background gags. Uncover disturbing secrets that were probably better left hidden.
